content:
Next month (24 July 2024), the University of Exeter is hosting a one-day workshop on interactive theorem proving on education and research. In person and online.

"A one-day workshop focused on how interactive theorem provers, like Lean and Isabelle, can be used in mathematics and computer science. This event is ideal for educators and researchers who use deductive proof.

No prior experience is necessary: the day starts and ends with hands-on sessions that provide practical experience for those unfamiliar with Lean."

Speakers: @Heather Macbeth , @Patrick Massot, Athina Thoma, @Kevin Buzzard , @Jeremy Avigad , @Achim Brucker, @Diego Marmsoler

Our local speakers, Achim Brucker and Diego Marmsoler, work in Cyber Security, principally in Isabelle/HOL.
Will parts of the workshop be recorded and shared for those who can't join?

Rick de Wolf said:

Will parts of the workshop be recorded and shared for those who can't join?

Yes, but please register if you haven't done so!
